eyebrow: Connecting to dw.* with sqlalchemy + pyodbc
code:
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
import pandas as pd

engine = create_engine(
  "mssql+pyodbc://@localhost/AdventureWorks2012"
  "?driver=ODBC+Driver+17+for+SQL+Server"
  "&trusted_connection=yes"
)
fact = pd.read_sql(
  "SELECT * FROM dw.FactProductSales", engine
)
caption: The same real connection pattern used to reach SQL Server from Python.
